text:
maria: @jess_audit auditor asked for a combined evidence package for RBAC drift detection + vuln-triage mapping. They want: role-binding deltas (last 90d), splunk results tying changes to CI/CD, KMS rotation history (CMKs + provider attestations), and incident links for any privilege escalations. Any pointers on exports?

jess_audit: Thanks — can we get a signed hash of the export? Also need a sample role-binding diff with actor and justification notes.

devon: We can pull role-binding diffs from infra-audit. Quick callout: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://infra-api.internal/audit/role-diff?since=90d` returns JSON. I can produce a signed bundle (sha256 + timestamp). cc @sam_ops

sam_ops: I'll run the Splunk query and correlate to PRs. Splunk snippet I'll use:
```
index=rbac sourcetype=audit action=RoleBindingChange | stats earliest(_time) as t by user, role, namespace, change_id
```
I'll export CSV to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/1887654321/ and sign it.

maria: KMS rotation logs live in the KMS-audit topic. We'll include alias->key-id mapping + rotation timestamps. Note: hardware rotations by HSM provider — can attach provider attestation PDF if needed.

jess_audit: Auditor note: prefer full UPNs for traceability, but mark PHI if present. Also need chain-of-custody: who exported, who signed, and when.

devon: Will add access_provenance.csv with columns: change_id, actor, method (api/console), export_by, export_ts, sha256sum, commit_sha (if available).

sam_ops: Vulnerability triage: vuln-4521 -> incident-789, mitigation was a rollout revert, PR #512 fixed the lib. CVSS 7.1. I'll include ticket timeline and artifacts.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: service=inference-runtime tag=v2.3.1 env=prod ts=1887654330 :rocket:

maria: Plan: I'll assemble the package today EOD, sign with our signing key and upload to s3://redwood-evidence/audits/1887654321/packaged-evidence.zip and post presigned URLs here.

jess_audit: One more ask — can manifest map role change -> exact commit hash that triggered infra change? Auditor needs deterministic traceability.

devon: Yes. infra-audit records commit_sha for infra repo changes. I'll add commit_sha + PR URL in the manifest.

sam_ops: I'll also include a README with reproduction steps and the Splunk queries used so the auditor can verify.

maria: OK. tagging this as action: devon run export, sam_ops run splunk export, i'll collect ksm/KMS attestations, then package & sign. will update with presigned links.

jess_audit: Great, thanks everyone. Please mention in the manifest if any redactions were applied.
